scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: This artificial collection consists of miscellaneous records in the Revolutionary War / Revolutionary Government record group (R.G. 2) at the Library of Viginia. Collection includes certificates.

Contains a certificate of an oath of John Philips taken before Cha[rles] Binns, Clerk of the Loudoun County Court, regarding the loss of a certificate belonging to William Jones for his pay and depreciation in the service of the Virginia Line during the Revolutionary War. (Accession 45175)

Contains a letter from D[emsey] Butler to Col. Josiah Parker requesting a pardon and permission to return to duty. On the back of the letter is a note from Parker pardoning Butler for his past offenses if he reports to camp. (Accession 44307)

unittitle.emph: List of deserters from Lt. G. Spencer's Company of Militia (Accession 44288),

scopecontent.p: Contains a list of deserters from Lt. G[ideon] Spencer's Company of Militia, Charlotte County. (Accession 44288)

unittitle.emph: List of officers of the Virginia Line who have been killed, wounded, resigned, or superceeded (Accession 45136),

scopecontent.p: Contains a list of officers of the Virginia Line who have been killed, wounded, resigned, or superceeded since the Chesterfield arrangement in February 1781 and not included in the late arrangement in May. Includes original and a transcription. A portion of the original document has been torn off and is missing. (Accession 45136)
